highlights: Five banks were given a 10‑day deadline to release the deposits and accrued profit.
Banks cite restrictions on payments from institutional accounts pending treasury approval.

loan_rates_steady_sep2026.headline: China to Hold Loan Prime Rate Steady for 16th Month Amid Global Rate Tightening
loan_rates_steady_sep2026.summary: China is expected to keep its benchmark loan prime rate unchanged for the 16th month, reflecting cautious policy despite hawkish moves by major central banks worldwide.
highlights: Benchmark loan prime rate (LPR) to remain unchanged for the 16th consecutive month
Policymakers aim to avoid fresh stimulus as global central banks adopt tighter monetary stances
The People's Bank of China signals continued stability in credit conditions

spectrum_renewal.headline: Bangladesh's High Spectrum Renewal Fees Threaten Telecom Investment
spectrum_renewal.summary: Renewal of 79.2 MHz of spectrum at some of the world’s highest prices could force Bangladesh’s mobile operators to cut network upgrades and delay 5G rollouts.
highlights: Operators must pay roughly Tk237 crore per MHz, four to six times Nordic rates.
Spectrum fees represent about 16% of operators’ recurring revenue, far above the global average.
The BTRC will review pricing after GSMA criticism and a 700 MHz auction controversy.

saarc_revive.headline: Bangladesh Urges Bhutan to Back SAARC Revitalisation Effort
saarc_revive.summary: Bangladesh appealed to Bhutan’s Prime Minister Tshering Tobgay for support in reviving the South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation, citing shared regional benefits.
highlights: Bangladesh’s ministers met the Bhutanese leader at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport
Bangladesh offered skilled personnel to assist Bhutan’s Gelephu Mindfulness City project
Bhutan was the first nation to recognise Bangladesh’s independence in 1971

rajshahi_silk_exports.headline: UK Opens New Doors for Rajshahi Silk and Jute Exports
rajshahi_silk_exports.summary: British High Commissioner Sarah Cooke highlighted growing UK demand for Rajshahi silk, jute, mangoes and other Bangladeshi products, urging visa simplification and sector diversification.
highlights: British High Commissioner met RCCI to discuss expanding exports of silk, jute, mangoes, food grains and fish to the UK
She called for simplified business visa procedures to boost trade and tourism
UK interest also includes Bangladeshi leather, spices and traditional pitha

spectrum_pricing_review.headline: Bangladesh Mobile Spectrum Prices Far Exceed Regional Benchmarks
spectrum_pricing_review.summary: Bangladesh's recent 2.3 GHz and 2.6 GHz auctions priced spectrum at roughly $6 million per MHz, costing operators about 16% of revenue versus lower regional rates.
highlights: Spectrum fees represent roughly 55% of total market revenue when taxes and levies are included.
India's 3.3 GHz auction fetched only $1.8‑2.1 million per MHz, far below Bangladesh's price.

port_workers_protest_dpworld.headline: Bangladesh Port Workers Protest DP World Takeover of New Mooring Terminal
port_workers_protest_dpworld.summary: Port workers demand the withdrawal of cases and reject the proposed handover of Chattogram’s New Mooring Container Terminal to Dubai‑based DP World, citing profit and job concerns.
highlights: Workers plan a human chain protest on 22 September and a procession on 27 September.
The NCT reportedly generates around Tk2,500 crore in net profit annually.
Workers warn that foreign control could trigger capital outflows and job losses.

titas_well_gas_supply.headline: New Titas‑28 Well Adds 12.5 mmcfd to Bangladesh’s Gas Grid
titas_well_gas_supply.summary: The newly inaugurated Titas‑28 well in Brahmanbaria will supply 12.5 mmcfd of natural gas to the national grid, easing Bangladesh’s current supply shortage.
highlights: The well cost around Tk200 crore to drill
Government plans to drill 150 wells by 2030
Three more Titas wells could add 45 mmcfd

us_state_department_under_pressure_to_di.headline: US State Department Faces Calls to Reveal Venezuelan Oil Revenue Details
us_state_department_under_pressure_to_di.summary: Advocates and lawmakers are urging the State Department to publish how much oil income the United States has received from Venezuela amid growing scrutiny.
highlights: Congressional committees have requested a breakdown of Venezuelan oil payments to the U.S.
Human rights groups argue transparency is needed to assess sanctions compliance

digital_bank_licences.headline: Bangladesh to Issue Digital Bank Licences Amid Inclusion Push
digital_bank_licences.summary: Finance Minister Amir Khosru Mahmud Chowdhury announced plans for digital bank licences, linking them to stronger digital infrastructure and broader financial inclusion.
highlights: Minister emphasizes gradual rollout with focus on cybersecurity and credit information integration
Stakeholders warn that zero merchant discount rates risk cost shifts to consumers, threatening inclusion
Former central bank governor notes Bangla QR misuse concerns and need for national QR standards

house_rent_allowance.headline: Bangladesh Gov’t Introduces New House Rent Allowance Up to 60% for Dhaka Staff
house_rent_allowance.summary: From 1 July, government employees will receive house rent allowances between 25% and 60% of basic salary, with Dhaka staff getting the highest rate.
highlights: Allowance rates vary by grade and location, e.g., 60% for Grade 20‑16 in Dhaka
Special allowance ends; any paid after 1 July will be adjusted against salary arrears

spectrum_price_policy.headline: High Spectrum Prices Risk Leaving Valuable Bangladeshi Bands Unused
spectrum_price_policy.summary: Rising spectrum fees may make 1500 MHz, 3500 MHz and millimetre‑wave bands unaffordable for operators, threatening network expansion and 5G rollout in Bangladesh.
highlights: Bangladesh plans a major spectrum renewal in November
GSMA study suggests aligning prices with regional benchmarks to boost investment
Former ICT adviser Faiz Ahmed Taiyeb urges pricing that prioritises coverage over short‑term revenue

us_china_trade_teams_to_meet_in_new_york.headline: US and China Trade Teams Meet in New York to Discuss AI and Iran
us_china_trade_teams_to_meet_in_new_york.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng will negotiate trade issues, AI policy and Iran sanctions ahead of the Trump‑Xi summit.
highlights: Bessent and He will hold talks in New York on Sunday
The meeting aims to set the agenda for the September 24 Washington summit between Donald Trump and Xi Jinping
Discussions will focus on trade, artificial intelligence cooperation, and Iran‑related sanctions

pboc_adviser_warns_ai_could_worsen_suppl.headline: China Central Bank Adviser Warns AI May Worsen Supply‑Demand Gap
pboc_adviser_warns_ai_could_worsen_suppl.summary: AI adoption could deepen China's persistent excess supply and weak domestic demand, prompting officials to push consumption‑boosting policies and balance‑sheet repairs.
highlights: Exports have risen this year as global AI demand supports Chinese manufacturers.
Policymakers cite a prolonged property slump and local‑government debt as key demand constraints.

banks_encounter_data_privacy_hurdles_whi.headline: European Banks Clash with Data‑Privacy Rules While Assessing Weather Risk
banks_encounter_data_privacy_hurdles_whi.summary: Banks in Europe are struggling to meet regulator demands for wildfire, drought and flood risk assessment as client data‑privacy rules limit data access.
highlights: Regulators are intensifying scrutiny of banks' credit‑risk and pricing models for extreme weather exposure
Banks report growing frustration due to privacy barriers that restrict access to client data needed for risk analysis
The focus is on wildfires, droughts and floods as climate‑related losses rise across the continent

bank_crisis_npl.headline: Bank Mergers Alone Won’t Fix Bangladesh’s Banking Crisis, Says MTB CEO
bank_crisis_npl.summary: Mutual Trust Bank CEO warns that merging weak banks cannot address the sector’s soaring non‑performing loans, capital shortfalls and governance flaws.
highlights: Non‑performing loans have surged to over Tk 600,000 crore, representing more than 32% of total loans.
The sector’s capital adequacy ratio fell to –2.64% in 2025, well below the 10% regulatory minimum.
Implementing IFRS 9 could expose further credit‑risk gaps, making fresh capital insufficient on its own.

gold_price_spike.headline: Bangladesh gold prices jump Tk1,691 per bhori
gold_price_spike.summary: Bangladesh Jewellers Association raised 22‑carat gold to Tk2,34,621 per bhori, including VAT, effective from 10 am on 19 September today.
highlights: 22‑carat gold price increased by Tk1,691 to Tk2,34,621 per bhori
21‑carat gold set at Tk2,24,065 and 18‑carat at Tk1,92,398 per bhori
22‑carat silver also rose, now Tk5,132 per bhori

dse_weekly_gain.headline: DSE indexes eke modest weekly gain as buying revives beaten‑down stocks
dse_weekly_gain.summary: Renewed investor interest, government gas supply assurances, and regulator‑broker engagement lifted the DSEX to 5,532, though market breadth stayed weak.
highlights: DSEX rose 16 points while DS30 added nearly five points
Textile stocks led turnover at 25.7% of total trading volume
Market capitalisation fell about Tk700 crore despite turnover rise

ecb_vigilance_statement.headline: ECB Must Remain Vigilant on Inflation Risks, Says Governing Council Member Stournaras
ecb_vigilance_statement.summary: ECB Governor Yannis Stournaras warns of potential upside inflation pressures but advises against hasty policy moves amid absent second‑round wage effects.
highlights: Stournaras stresses monitoring inflation without premature rate changes
No clear evidence yet of wage‑driven second‑round inflation
ECB’s cautious stance aims to preserve price‑stability credibility

2027_budget_eu_guidelines.headline: France Claims 2027 Budget Aligns with EU Spending Rules
2027_budget_eu_guidelines.summary: France's draft 2027 budget proposes a 0.7% rise in net primary spending, staying within the EU's 1.2% ceiling despite debt exceeding 120% of GDP.
highlights: Net primary expenditure increase limited to 0.7%
EU recommends spending growth no higher than 1.2%
Debt burden projected to surpass 120% of GDP

new_pay_scale_special_benefit_cut.headline: Bangladesh Cuts Pohela Boishakh Allowance to 15% Under New Pay Scale
new_pay_scale_special_benefit_cut.summary: The government’s new pay scale eliminates the special benefit and reduces the Pohela Boishakh allowance to 15% of basic salary, adjusting prior benefits against arrears.
highlights: Special benefit abolished; any paid before gazette will be offset against salary arrears from 31 July.
Employees on post‑retirement leave as of 1 July keep the pre‑gazette rate until leave ends.
Pohela Boishakh allowance lowered from 20% to 15% of basic salary.

new_pay_scale_pension_increase.headline: Bangladesh Raises Government Pensions to Tk70,200 Under New Pay Scale
new_pay_scale_pension_increase.summary: The government announced a new pay structure that lifts monthly pensions for retirees to between Tk18,000 and Tk70,200, with increases up to 100%.
highlights: Pensions now range from Tk18,000 to Tk70,200 depending on prior amounts
Retirees will receive two festival allowances each year equal to their net pension
Pensioners earning over Tk70,200 will see no change until July 2027

india_bangladesh_economic_ties_statement.headline: India and Bangladesh Maintain Broad‑Based Partnership Amid 2024 Political Transition
india_bangladesh_economic_ties_statement.summary: The Indian MEA’s 2025‑26 report affirms that despite Bangladesh’s 2024 political shift, the two nations sustain strong people‑to‑people ties and expanding economic cooperation.
highlights: Bangladesh was India’s largest trading partner in South Asia in 2024‑25, with bilateral trade reaching $13.49 billion.
India supplied 420 railway freight wagons and is advancing the BBIN Motor Vehicle Agreement to boost regional connectivity.
The Joint Rivers Commission held its 88th meeting, sharing real‑time flood forecasts across 54 transboundary rivers.

macron_carney_meeting_in_saint_pierre.headline: Macron Meets Canadian Prime Minister in Saint Pierre Amid US Trade Tensions
macron_carney_meeting_in_saint_pierre.summary: President Macron's visit to Saint Pierre and Miquelon to meet Prime Minister Carney underscores France's Atlantic sovereignty and deepening EU‑Canada trade ties despite Trump’s provocations.
highlights: Macron's first presidential visit to the archipelago since 2014
The meeting follows Trump's social‑media post displaying the territory under the U.S. flag
France aims to reinforce maritime sovereignty and discuss the energy crisis with Canada

draft_public_procurement_ordinance_appro.headline: Bangladesh Cabinet Approves Draft Procurement Ordinance to Boost Competition
draft_public_procurement_ordinance_appro.summary: The cabinet endorsed the 2026 Public Procurement Amendment Ordinance, aiming to protect local industries, expand limited tendering and introduce rated‑criteria evaluation for government contracts.
highlights: Rated‑criteria based bids will assess proposals on price and quality metrics
Alternative Procurement Arrangement can be used for urgent state needs
E‑tendering simplification is under consideration by the Local Government Division

stocks_rally_as_dsex_gains_60_points_tur.headline: DSEX climbs 60 points as turnover hits Tk747 crore
stocks_rally_as_dsex_gains_60_points_tur.summary: The Dhaka Stock Exchange opened the week with a 60‑point surge in the DSEX index and a 14% rise in daily turnover to Tk747 crore.
highlights: DSEX rose 60 points, driven by broad‑based buying
Turnover increased 14% to Tk747 crore
Eastern Bank led trading volume, followed by Sharp Industries and IPDC Finance

gold_paste_worth_tk7_5_cr_recovered_from.headline: Customs Seizes Tk7.5 Crore Gold Paste from Dhaka Airport Commode
gold_paste_worth_tk7_5_cr_recovered_from.summary: Customs intelligence officers recovered 4.204 kg of suspected gold paste worth about Tk7.5 crore from a commode tank at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport on September 19.
highlights: Four‑kilogram gold‑like paste was found in eight egg‑shaped packets wrapped in polythene.
The recovery was carried out after a tip‑off and witnessed by multiple intelligence agencies.

ai_trade_critical_minerals_talks.headline: US Treasury Chief Bessent and China’s He Launch AI, Trade, Mineral Talks
ai_trade_critical_minerals_talks.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Vice Premier He Lifeng will meet to negotiate AI cooperation, tariff adjustments, and critical mineral supply deals before the upcoming US‑China summit.
highlights: The existing US‑China trade truce expires on November 10.
He will head a delegation of Chinese firms to the United States.
Discussions aim to set groundwork for agreements at the Washington summit.

memory_chip_mass_production.headline: China's CXMT launches fifth‑generation DRAM platform into mass production
memory_chip_mass_production.summary: CXMT announced its new fifth‑generation DRAM platform is now in mass production, delivering chips that hold 50% more data per wafer.
highlights: New DRAM chips provide 50% higher data capacity than previous models
Production yields at least 50% more chip dies per wafer
The move challenges established global memory‑chip suppliers

2026_growth_forecast_tripled.headline: Germany's IW Institute Triples 2026 Growth Forecast to 1.2%
2026_growth_forecast_tripled.summary: Germany is expected to expand its economy by nearly 1.2% in 2026, driven by stronger exports and increased government spending in the first half.
highlights: IW raised its forecast from 0.4% to 1.2%
Ifo, DIW, RWI and IMK also upgraded their growth forecasts
Momentum may weaken later as high energy prices and weak private investment weigh on demand

bangladesh_canada_trade_talks.headline: Bangladesh and Canada Seek Expanded Trade and Climate Cooperation Ahead of UNGA
bangladesh_canada_trade_talks.summary: Bangladesh and Canada discussed diversifying trade beyond garments, boosting agriculture and energy ties, and securing climate financing support as the UNGA approaches.
highlights: Both nations aim to increase bilateral trade in light engineering and machinery.
Canada reaffirmed its commitment to the voluntary return of Rohingya refugees.
The Bangladeshi diaspora in Canada exceeds 100,000, strengthening bilateral relations.

nbr_freight_forwarding_policy.headline: BAFFA urges NBR to bar fully foreign‑owned firms from freight forwarding licences
nbr_freight_forwarding_policy.summary: The Bangladesh Freight Forwarders Association asked the National Board of Revenue to prohibit 100% foreign‑owned companies from obtaining freight forwarding licences to safeguard domestic economic benefits.
highlights: BAFFA proposes scrapping the 1% tax deducted at source on gross billing and denominating air freight rates in taka
It also suggests a 5% incentive for freight forwarding income repatriated through legal banking channels

takapay_debit_cards.headline: TakaPay Debit Cards to Empower Bangladesh Family Card Beneficiaries
takapay_debit_cards.summary: The government will issue TakaPay debit cards to all Family Card recipients, enabling ATM cash withdrawals and POS purchases via the national payment switch.
highlights: Cards will be linked to accounts at Sonali Bank, Janata Bank and Bangladesh Krishi Bank, with other banks joining the TakaPay
No transaction fees are charged by Bangladesh Bank, and only minimal card‑issuance fees apply, making TakaPay cheaper than Visa

yen_vulnerability.headline: Yen Faces Sharp Decline as Holiday Liquidity Drops and BOJ Guidance Disappoints
yen_vulnerability.summary: The yen slipped up to 1.3% against the dollar, with reduced liquidity from Japan’s three‑day holiday and weak guidance from the Bank of Japan on future rate hikes.
highlights: Three‑day holiday in Japan will thin FX market liquidity
BOJ raised rates but offered limited forward guidance
Yen fell to 156.88 per dollar, its steepest slide this week

local_bond_preference.headline: Emerging‑Market Investors Shift to Local Bonds as Dollar Debt Falters
local_bond_preference.summary: With Treasury yields climbing, investors are preferring local‑currency sovereign bonds in emerging markets, drawn by better valuations and carry‑trade opportunities.
highlights: Treasury yields have risen sharply, reducing demand for dollar‑denominated emerging‑market bonds
Local‑currency sovereign bonds provide higher yields and attractive price levels
Investors use carry‑trade strategies, borrowing cheap dollars to buy higher‑yielding local assets

new_local_platform.headline: Qatar Launches Doha Investment Platform to Boost Domestic Wealth Fund
new_local_platform.summary: Qatar’s new Doha Investment platform will manage its multi‑hundred‑billion‑dollar sovereign wealth fund domestically, aiming to accelerate value creation and increase private‑sector participation.
highlights: The platform is named Doha Investment and will oversee the domestic portfolio of the fund.
Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani announced the initiative at the Qatar Economic Forum in New York.

fuel_price_hike_sep2026.headline: Bangladesh Fuel Price Hike Triggers Surge in Daily Essentials Costs
fuel_price_hike_sep2026.summary: Higher transport fares after the recent fuel price hike have pushed up prices of vegetables, eggs, fish, chicken, flour and milk across Dhaka markets.
highlights: Vegetable prices rose Tk10‑30 per kg and farm eggs crossed Tk160 per dozen within a week
Chicken and fish prices increased as transport costs rose, while packaged flour and milk saw further hikes
Bottled soybean oil supply tightened, prompting a Tk5 per litre price increase

rig_purchase_gas_discovery_2026.headline: Petrobangla Accelerates Gas Production by Adding New Drilling Rigs
rig_purchase_gas_discovery_2026.summary: Petrobangla aims to drill 118 wells by 2029‑30, adding rigs to boost domestic gas output and reduce reliance on costly imported LNG.
highlights: Plan targets 118 wells, delivering up to 1,752 mmcfd by FY2029‑30.
Current fleet has only two active development rigs; a 2,000‑hp rig and a 1,500‑hp unit are being procured.
Only three of the 118 wells have received Ecnec funding, and many projects face bureaucratic delays.

foreign_universities_branches_policy.headline: Bangladesh UGC Drafts Policy to Permit Foreign University Branches
foreign_universities_branches_policy.summary: The University Grants Commission will draft a Cross‑Border Higher Education Policy allowing foreign universities to open campuses in Bangladesh while enabling local universities to establish overseas branches.
highlights: Foreign universities may open branch campuses or study centres in Bangladesh under the new policy.
Eligible private Bangladeshi universities will soon be allowed to launch PhD programmes aligned with emerging technology fields.
Joint scholarships, internships and joint‑degree programmes are being expanded with partners like Malaysia’s UCSI University.

us_china_trade_talks_ny_2026.headline: US and China Commence Trade Talks in New York Ahead of Summit
us_china_trade_talks_ny_2026.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng met in New York to lay groundwork for the Trump‑Xi summit, aiming to preserve the trade truce.
highlights: Negotiators will address trade, investment, artificial intelligence, and the Iran war.
The talks aim to extend the existing fragile trade truce between the two economies.

gulf_stocks_fall_houthi_claims.headline: Saudi and Gulf markets tumble after Houthis claim missile strikes on Riyadh
gulf_stocks_fall_houthi_claims.summary: Saudi Arabia’s stock market opened lower on Sunday as the Houthis’ alleged missile and drone attacks on Riyadh dampened investor sentiment across Gulf exchanges.
highlights: Saudi index fell amid reports of missile strikes on King Khalid International Airport
Gulf bourses mirrored the decline, reflecting regional geopolitical risk
Houthis said they targeted "sensitive" sites, heightening security concerns

junk_property_debt_fears_2023.headline: Europe’s Junk Property Debt Shows Strain Amid Rising Interest Rates
junk_property_debt_fears_2023.summary: Higher interest rates are forcing European junk‑property bond issuers like Net Zero Properties to scrap financing plans, reviving fears of a 2023‑style debt crisis.
highlights: Net Zero Properties cancelled a €500 million junk bond after investors rejected sweetened terms
Hybrid securities of landlords Aroundtown and CPI Property Group fell sharply this month
The rare cancellation signals widening credit stress in Europe’s junk‑property market

retail_banking_closure.headline: Standard Chartered Bangladesh to Sell Retail Banking Portfolio in Competitive Bidding
retail_banking_closure.summary: Standard Chartered Bangladesh will divest its retail banking portfolio, representing 28% of its assets, as part of a global shift toward corporate and wealth management.
highlights: Retail and CMSME portfolio valued at Tk 8,479 crore, 28% of total assets
Potential buyers include BRAC Bank and City Bank, with a bidding process slated for September‑October
Retail deposits amount to Tk 8,000 crore, roughly 20% of the bank’s total deposits

race_license_revocation.headline: BSEC Moves to Revoke RACE Asset Management Licence After Court Vacates Stay Order
race_license_revocation.summary: Bangladesh’s securities regulator is enforcing its investigation report, seeking to strip RACE of its licence and bar its leaders after a high court stay was lifted.
highlights: The commission’s report recommends cancelling registration of RACE’s ten mutual funds and redeeming units under trustee
Authorities have fined RACE Tk55 lakh and the CID filed a money‑laundering case involving Tk1,613 crore.

new_consulates_establishment.headline: Bangladesh to Open Consulates in Guangzhou, Frankfurt, and São Paulo
new_consulates_establishment.summary: Dhaka will establish consulates general in Guangzhou, Frankfurt and São Paulo to boost diplomatic representation, trade links and services for expatriates.
highlights: Guangzhou chosen for its major port and existing Bangladeshi business community
Frankfurt aims to deepen ties with the EU, Bangladesh’s largest export market
São Paulo will enhance Bangladesh’s footprint in Brazil and the broader Latin American market

us_china_ai_dialogue_and_trade_talks_ahe.headline: US and China Initiate AI Dialogue and Advance Trade Talks Ahead of Summit
us_china_ai_dialogue_and_trade_talks_ahe.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng agreed to start an AI dialogue while pushing forward trade negotiations before the Trump‑Xi summit.
highlights: The parties will establish a regular AI dialogue to address shared goals and security risks.
Trade negotiator Li Chenggang confirmed that bilateral trade talks will resume in the coming weeks.

hawkish_3_75_rate_call_for_bank_of_korea.headline: JPMorgan Predicts Bank of Korea to Reach 3.75% Amid Inflation Risks
hawkish_3_75_rate_call_for_bank_of_korea.summary: JPMorgan forecasts the Bank of Korea will lift its benchmark to 3.75% by early 2027, citing semiconductor‑driven growth and potential inflation pressures.
highlights: JPMorgan expects rate hikes in November, February and May, exceeding the 3.5% median Bloomberg forecast.
The outlook assumes stable credit markets despite higher inflation risks from the semiconductor sector.

ft.com/content/d29d769e-039c-4d11-9152-e.headline: Scott Bessent praises US‑China AI dialogue ahead of Trump‑Xi summit
ft.com/content/d29d769e-039c-4d11-9152-e.summary: Asset‑manager Scott Bessent lauds the upcoming US‑China artificial‑intelligence talks as a positive step toward easing tech tensions before the Trump‑Xi meeting.
highlights: Bessent sees AI cooperation as a way to reduce strategic rivalry
The dialogue is scheduled before the high‑level Trump‑Xi summit
US and China aim to set joint standards for emerging AI technologies

yarn_fabric_import_permission_removed.headline: Bangladesh Removes Ministry Permission for Yarn and Fabric Imports
yarn_fabric_import_permission_removed.summary: The government scrapped the mandatory Ministry of Commerce approval for importing yarn and fabric, aiming to speed customs clearance for garment exporters.
highlights: Exporters faced delays as shipments stalled without ministry permission
Local mills already supply most yarn and fabric but imports continue for specific buyer needs

fuel_surcharge_request.headline: Chittagong Port berth operators demand fuel surcharge as diesel spikes 69%
fuel_surcharge_request.summary: Berth operators at Chittagong Port have asked the authority to raise container handling rates after diesel prices jumped to Tk135 per litre, a 69% increase since 2022.
highlights: Diesel price rose by Tk20 per litre on 20 September, reaching Tk135 per litre.
The Bangladesh Ship Handling and Berth Operators Association sent the request to Chairman Rear Admiral S M Moniruzzaman.

textile_sector_policy_support.headline: President Calls for Integrated Policy Support to Boost Bangladesh Textile Sector
textile_sector_policy_support.summary: President Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir urged realistic, integrated policies to strengthen the textile industry, emphasizing its role in foreign earnings and employment amid energy challenges.
highlights: BTMA delegation met the President at Bangabhaban to discuss sector issues
Government aims to improve energy security and allow yarn imports via bank guarantees

future_blockbuster_launches_disappointin.headline: Novo Nordisk Misses Investor Expectations After Obesity Market Setback
future_blockbuster_launches_disappointin.summary: Investors were disappointed as Novo Nordisk pledged over $23 billion in new sales but lost its obesity market lead to Eli Lilly.
highlights: Shares fell up to 7.7% after the capital markets day announcement
Company aims to launch more than five blockbuster drugs in coming years
Loss of market leadership to Eli Lilly highlights intense competition in obesity treatments

obu_forex_rules.headline: Bangladesh Bank lets offshore units trade forex directly, use swaps
obu_forex_rules.summary: Bangladesh Bank approved offshore banking units to buy and sell foreign currency directly and conduct cross‑currency swaps, aiming to cut funding costs and better manage exchange‑rate risk.
highlights: OBUs can now transact outright foreign‑currency purchases and sales with domestic banks and other authorised dealers
The new rules permit cross‑currency swaps to hedge exposure and optimise funding structures
Transactions must be linked to permissible customer activities or liquidity management requirements

fuel_hike_stock_selloff.headline: Fuel Price Hike Triggers Sharp DSE Decline, Ends Four-Day Rally
fuel_hike_stock_selloff.summary: The government’s Tk20 per litre fuel price increase sparked a 0.74% fall in the DSEX, reversing a four‑session winning streak amid inflation fears.
highlights: DSEX dropped 41 points to 5,550, while turnover rose 6% to Tk788 crore.
Walton Hi‑Tech led losses with an 11.96% plunge after its post‑dividend adjustment.

tk20_fuel_hike_economic_pain.headline: Tk20 Fuel Hike Triggers Higher Transport Costs and Food Prices in Bangladesh
tk20_fuel_hike_economic_pain.summary: A Tk20‑per‑litre increase in fuel prices is pushing bus fares, ride‑sharing costs, freight rates and farm irrigation expenses higher, threatening household budgets.
highlights: Public transport fares in Dhaka rose by up to Tk10 per ride, and long‑distance bus tickets increased by up to Tk50.
Truck freight rates at Benapole jumped from around Tk22,000 to as high as Tk30,000 per shipment.
Diesel‑dependent irrigation accounts for about 20‑25% of Boro rice production costs, amplifying farmers’ expenses.

warner_paramount_settlement_2026_09_21.headline: Warner Bros Discovery and Paramount Skydance Shares Surge Amid California Settlement Talks
warner_paramount_settlement_2026_09_21.summary: Shares of Warner Bros Discovery and Paramount Skydance rose sharply after reports that the companies are negotiating a settlement with California’s attorney general to resolve antitrust concerns.
highlights: Warner Bros Discovery and Paramount Skydance stocks jumped after the settlement report
California attorney general is mediating the dispute to clear a merger hurdle
The talks aim to address U.S. antitrust scrutiny of the proposed merger

bird_flu_outbreak_in_children.headline: Children in Bangladesh Contract Bird Flu Amid Rising Poultry Risks
bird_flu_outbreak_in_children.summary: Four child H5N1 cases this year highlight the need for stronger poultry surveillance and preventive measures to protect vulnerable rural populations.
highlights: All four 2026 infections involved children, with one fatality
Virus transmission linked to direct contact with domestic ducks and chickens
Experts call for mandatory masks, gloves, and hand‑washing for poultry workers

fuel_price_hike_announcement.headline: Bangladesh Govt’s Tk 20 Fuel Price Hike Sparks Jamaat Protest
fuel_price_hike_announcement.summary: Jamaat-e-Islami warns that the sudden Tk 20 per litre fuel increase will deepen household financial strain and push essential commodity prices higher.
highlights: Government raised fuel prices by Tk 20 per litre in a single step.
Jamaat says the hike will raise costs for agriculture, factories and transport, inflating commodity prices.
Party urges withdrawal of the decision and stricter market monitoring.

guide_to_surviving_fuel_hikes.headline: Bangladesh Faces Triple Fuel Hike, Calls for EV and Buffalo Train Solutions
guide_to_surviving_fuel_hikes.summary: Petroleum prices jumped to Tk165 per litre, prompting transport fare hikes of up to 25% and sparking proposals for electric bikes, battery rickshaws, and buffalo‑powered trains.
highlights: Octane price rose from Tk125 to Tk165, with fears of a possible Tk200 ceiling.
Truck and bus operators announced fare increases of 20‑25% to cover higher fuel costs.
Experts suggest shifting to electric bikes, solar‑powered vehicles, and battery‑rickshaw vans to mitigate the impact.

diesel_price_hike_debate.institution: Ministry of Power, Energy and Mineral Resources
diesel_price_hike_debate.headline: Bangladesh Diesel Hike Sparks BNP-NCP Dispute Over Regional Prices
diesel_price_hike_debate.summary: Bangladesh raised diesel, octane, petrol and kerosene by Tk20 per litre, prompting BNP and NCP to clash over reported prices in India and Sri Lanka.
highlights: Government increased diesel price to Tk135 per litre, matching hikes in octane, petrol and kerosene.
BNP cites diesel at Tk134.76 in Kolkata and Tk179.42 in Sri Lanka, while NCP reports lower figures of Tk128 and Tk142
Global Petrol Prices shows regional diesel rates near Tk125.70 in India and Tk178.47 in Sri Lanka as of 14 September.

governor_india_imports_investment_meetin.headline: Bangladesh Bank Governor Urges India to Boost Imports and Investment
governor_india_imports_investment_meetin.summary: Governor Md Mostaqur Rahman appealed to India for higher Bangladeshi imports and increased investment in the nation’s technology‑driven manufacturing and digital payment sectors.
highlights: India’s High Commissioner Dinesh Trivedi met the governor at Bangladesh Bank headquarters
Bangladesh Bank has streamlined foreign investment rules, allowing easy repatriation of capital and profits
The governor highlighted interest in expanding Bangla QR and cross‑border digital payments

transport_fare_hike_policy.headline: Government pledges modest transport fare rise to ease public hardship
transport_fare_hike_policy.summary: Prime Minister's adviser Zahed Ur Rahman announced the government will limit transport fare increases while expanding food assistance to mitigate the impact of recent fuel price hikes.
highlights: The IMF has no condition requiring Bangladesh to raise fuel prices.
The government plans to expand Open Market Sale (OMS) food assistance programmes.
Transport fare hikes will be kept reasonable despite volatile global oil markets.

dse_compensation_to_fraud_victims.headline: DSE to Compensate 17,332 Investors and Launch Risk‑Based Oversight
dse_compensation_to_fraud_victims.summary: The Dhaka Stock Exchange will begin compensating 17,332 fraud‑hit investors from September 28 while introducing risk‑based capital supervision and digital monitoring to curb brokerage embezzlement.
highlights: The Investment Protection Fund will cover up to Tk5 lakh per investor, amounting to Tk37.60 crore in new payouts.
Five defaulted brokerages collectively embezzled Tk250 crore, prompting legal action by the ACC and BSEC.

prime_finance_liquidity_crisis.headline: Prime Finance seeks fine waiver amid mounting losses and NPA crisis
prime_finance_liquidity_crisis.summary: Prime Finance, a Bangladeshi NBFI, faces a Tk14.045 million fine waiver request as high non‑performing loans and cumulative losses cripple its ability to repay depositors.
highlights: 78% of its loan portfolio is classified as non‑performing.
Cumulative loss reached Tk351 crore and net asset value per share is negative Tk0.39.
Shares trade in DSE’s Z category, closing at Tk2.90.

gold_bars_seized_in_flight_toilet.headline: Gold Bars Worth Tk11 Crore Discovered in Biman Flight Toilet
gold_bars_seized_in_flight_toilet.summary: Customs intelligence officials uncovered 50 gold bars, weighing about 6 kg and valued at Tk11 crore, hidden inside a Biman Bangladesh Airlines aircraft’s toilet after its arrival from Singapore.
highlights: 50 gold bars were recovered from the aircraft’s toilet at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport
The National Board of Revenue announced no passenger involvement but launched an investigation into the smuggling operation
Customs Intelligence and Investigation Directorate pledged continued surveillance to seize larger gold consignments

yen_carry_trade_risk.headline: Yen Carry Trade Faces Rising Risks as Interest Rates Diverge
yen_carry_trade_risk.summary: Investors betting on the yen’s low rates to fund higher‑yielding assets confront mounting volatility amid shifting monetary policies.
highlights: The yen’s near‑zero policy rate makes it a popular funding currency for carry trades.
Rising global rates and a potential Bank of Japan policy shift increase the trade’s exposure to sharp reversals.

wb_support_external_shocks.headline: World Bank to Back Bangladesh Against Oil, Gas and Supply‑Chain Shocks
wb_support_external_shocks.summary: Finance Minister Amir Khosru Mahmud Chowdhury announced that the World Bank will provide support to mitigate external oil, gas and supply‑chain disruptions while expanding youth entrepreneurship programmes.
highlights: Bangladesh aims for a trillion‑dollar economy by 2034 with increased export and remittance flows.
World Bank agreement includes 50‑50 grant‑loan schemes for young entrepreneurs and concessional financing for social programmes

bandwidth_market_competition.headline: Stakeholders Push for More Competition in Bangladesh International Bandwidth Market
bandwidth_market_competition.summary: Industry leaders urged authorities to open the submarine cable sector, citing falling bandwidth prices and the need for private investment to lower costs further.
highlights: Current bandwidth price is about Tk120 per Mbps.
Bangladesh uses roughly 13,500 Gbps of international capacity.
Stakeholders project competition could push prices to Tk60‑70 by 2027.

unauthorised_cylinder_gas_supply_halt.headline: Uttara‑Ashulia CNG Stations Ban Gas to Vehicles with Unauthorized Cylinders
unauthorised_cylinder_gas_supply_halt.summary: Following a deadly explosion, CNG stations in Uttara‑Ashulia will stop supplying gas to covered vans and lorries fitted with unauthorized cylinders.
highlights: Titas Gas issued written instructions prohibiting gas supply to vehicles with unauthorized cylinders
Association leader Tanvir Rahman says stations will no longer risk supplying gas after the Pretty Industrial Park incident
Enforcement responsibility lies with law‑enforcement agencies and magistrates, not Titas

fuel_hike_exporters_costs.headline: Fuel Hike Drives Up Transport, Port and Factory Costs for Bangladeshi Exporters
fuel_hike_exporters_costs.summary: Rising diesel prices have forced transport operators, inland container depots and port services to raise fees, squeezing exporters already battling weak demand.
highlights: Diesel surged 17.4% to Tk135 per litre, prompting a 9.85% hike in ICD charges.
Prime‑mover trip costs rose to Tk30,000‑Tk32,000, and truck fares at Benapole jumped up to Tk35,000.
Port berth operators seek higher rates as diesel‑powered equipment now costs nearly 69% more.

govt_fuel_tax_shift_against_pay_hike.headline: Bangladesh Raises Fuel Prices by Tk20/Litre Amid Pay Scale Upgrade, Skipping Tax Relief
govt_fuel_tax_shift_against_pay_hike.summary: The government lifted fuel prices by Tk20 per litre to offset Bangladesh Petroleum Corporation losses, even as it prepares a costly new pay scale for public workers.
highlights: Fuel taxes represent about 32% of import costs under the invoice‑value system.
BPC recorded net profits of Tk55,837 crore since FY15 despite recent losses.
Passenger bus fares rose 17 paisa per kilometre following the price hike.

taka_gains_against_rupee.headline: Bangladeshi Taka Gains 11.6% Against Indian Rupee Over Two Years
taka_gains_against_rupee.summary: The taka has appreciated 11.6% versus the rupee in two years, with a 7.6% rise in the last twelve months.
highlights: Tk 1 equals ₹0.781 on 22 Sep 2026, up from ₹0.726 a year earlier
One Indian rupee now costs Tk 1.281, down from Tk 1.3782 in 2025

oil_falls_on_increased_gulf_supply_and_h.headline: Oil dips below $100 as Saudi pipeline repairs boost Gulf supply and US‑Iran talks raise hopes
oil_falls_on_increased_gulf_supply_and_h.summary: Oil prices slipped modestly on Wednesday as Saudi Arabia’s pipeline restoration increased Gulf output and diplomatic optimism grew over US‑Iran negotiations.
highlights: Brent crude fell to $99.18 a barrel
Saudi East‑West pipeline repairs lifted regional supply
US crude inventories rose according to industry data

indian_shares_set_for_flat_open_as_forei.headline: Indian shares poised for flat open as foreign outflows counter Asian gains
indian_shares_set_for_flat_open_as_forei.summary: Indian equities are expected to open unchanged, with foreign fund withdrawals neutralizing gains from regional markets amid lingering Middle East tensions.
highlights: GIFT Nifty futures were at 23,343 points, indicating a flat start for the Nifty 50 index
Persistent foreign fund outflows offset the positive momentum in Asian markets
Asian shares were on track for a sixth consecutive session of gains

gdp_forecast_cut.headline: ADB cuts Bangladesh FY27 growth forecast to 4% amid inflation rise
gdp_forecast_cut.summary: The Asian Development Bank lowered Bangladesh’s FY2027 growth outlook to 4% and raised inflation expectations to 9%, citing banking stress and energy shortages.
highlights: Growth forecast cut to 4% from 4.5% for FY2027
Inflation outlook increased to 9% for FY2027
Current‑account deficit projected to widen to 0.6% of GDP

hilsa_import_halt.headline: Bangladesh Suspends Indian Hilsa Imports, Cancels 103 NOCs
hilsa_import_halt.summary: Bangladesh’s Department of Fisheries halted Indian hilsa imports on 23 September, cancelling 103 no‑objection certificates amid concerns over mislabeling and potential money‑laundering.
highlights: The department cancelled 103 NOCs, immediately suspending hilsa imports from India
Importers face losses as imported hilsa bought at Tk500/kg is sold locally for up to Tk3,000/kg
535 metric tonnes of hilsa had entered Bangladesh this year before the suspension

pm_wb_development_discussion.headline: Bangladesh Prime Minister Meets World Bank President to Boost Development Support
pm_wb_development_discussion.summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman and World Bank Group President Ajay Banga discussed Bangladesh’s development priorities and pledged to deepen partnership and financing support.
highlights: The meeting took place at the UN Headquarters in New York during the UN General Assembly.
Rahman will address the Assembly on September 24, outlining Bangladesh’s vision and regional stance.

dollar_near_2month_high.headline: Dollar Near Two‑Month High as Rate Hike Prospects and Iran Diplomacy Influence Markets
dollar_near_2month_high.summary: The U.S. dollar steadied close to a two‑month peak, buoyed by expectations of near‑term rate hikes and renewed Iran diplomatic talks.
highlights: Dollar near its strongest level in two months as investors price in possible Fed tightening
Oil prices fell, easing inflation pressures that could affect central bank decisions
Yen stays vulnerable amid lingering expectations of Japanese market intervention

energy_import_risk_reduction.headline: Bangladesh Can Slash Fuel Imports by Accelerating Electrification, IEA Says
energy_import_risk_reduction.summary: The IEA report warns that expanding electricity use in transport, textiles and agriculture could lower Bangladesh’s fuel import costs and protect foreign‑currency reserves.
highlights: Electric two‑ and three‑wheelers can travel ten times the average daily distance on a single charge, recouping higher upfront
Solar‑powered irrigation pumps offer a diesel‑free alternative for agriculture, which accounts for up to 19% of South Asia’s GDP.
Reliable grid upgrades and storage are essential, as weak electricity supply could hinder electrification despite potential

dsex_gain.headline: Bargain Hunting Drives DSEX Up 55 Points Amid Uncertainty
dsex_gain.summary: Investors flocked to undervalued stocks, lifting the DSEX by 55 points to 5,596 despite lingering economic and geopolitical concerns.
highlights: DSEX rose 1% to close at 5,596, with turnover up 7% to Tk844 crore.
Travel stocks led sector gains, rising 5.6%, while mutual funds fell 2.4%.
Top gainers included Orion Pharma (+10%) and Unique Hotel (+9.95%).

japan_desk_launch.institution: Bangladesh Garment Manufacturers and Exporters Association (BGMEA)
japan_desk_launch.headline: BGMEA launches Japan Desk to boost apparel exports to Japan
japan_desk_launch.summary: BGMEA aims to triple Bangladesh's apparel exports to Japan, targeting $3 billion by 2030 through a new Japan Desk facilitating buyer‑supplier matchmaking.
highlights: Around 100 garment factories have been selected to work with Japanese buyers
Bangladesh currently exports just over $1 billion of apparel to Japan, with a goal of $3 billion by 2030
The Japan Desk will help resolve disputes and encourage repeat business

bangladeshcroatiatradetie.headline: Bangladesh and Croatia Aim to Deepen Trade and Investment Ties
bangladeshcroatiatradetie.summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman and Croatian PM Andrej Plenković pledged to expand bilateral trade, investment, skilled labour and technology cooperation during their UN meeting.
highlights: Leaders met on the sidelines of the 81st UN General Assembly in New York
They committed to boost cooperation in education, technology and skilled manpower
They will coordinate positions in multilateral forums including the United Nations

fuelpricefuturecut.institution: Ministry of Power, Energy and Mineral Resources
fuelpricefuturecut.headline: Bangladesh to Cut Fuel Prices After Global Market Stabilises, Says State Minister
fuelpricefuturecut.summary: State Minister Aninda Islam Amit announced that domestic fuel prices will be reduced once international markets calm and the Middle East crisis eases, ending the recent hike.
highlights: International fuel, shipping and insurance costs surged between March and August, prompting a Tk22,875 crore loss for Bangladesh
The price cut aims to curb fuel smuggling to neighbouring countries and align Bangladesh with regional price levels

autorickshawassault.headline: Chattogram Traffic Police Assaulted by Battery‑Run Autorickshaw Driver
autorickshawassault.summary: A battery‑run autorickshaw driver attacked a traffic policeman and bit a sergeant before fleeing, highlighting ongoing tensions over unregistered electric rickshaws in Chattogram.
highlights: Driver grabbed a policeman and bit Sergeant Arman Hossain’s hand during a traffic stop at Dampara‑Nursery intersection.
Authorities cite lack of registration and absent state policy as challenges in controlling battery‑run autorickshaws.

revenue_evasion_foiled.headline: NBR uncovers Tk16 crore revenue evasion in cellulose acetate imports
revenue_evasion_foiled.summary: Bangladesh's National Board of Revenue seized 48,000 kg of cellulose acetate tow, exposing a Tk16 crore tax loss and potential Tk324 crore illicit cigarette revenue.
highlights: CIC seized over 48,000 kg of acetate tow imported under the fictitious company Unique Traders.
NBR estimates the concealed revenue could reach Tk324 crore if the material were used for cigarette production.
Four additional shell companies were identified for importing large acetate tow volumes without VAT filings.

oil_price_two_week_low.headline: Oil Near Two‑Week Lows as Diesel Cracks Surge to Record
oil_price_two_week_low.summary: Oil prices hovered near two‑week lows while European diesel premiums hit a record $95 per barrel amid talks of a US export ban.
highlights: Brent crude settled at $99.62 a barrel, while WTI fell to $90.08.
US crude inventories rose by 1.8 million barrels in the week to Sep 18, contrary to expectations.
Saudi Arabia resumed its East‑West pipeline to the Red Sea, boosting supply prospects.

gold_seizure_border.headline: BSF and DRI seize 12kg foreign gold in India‑Bangladesh border raids
gold_seizure_border.summary: Joint operations by the Border Security Force and Directorate of Revenue Intelligence confiscated about 12 kg of foreign‑origin gold worth roughly Rs 17 crore along the India‑Bangladesh frontier.
highlights: Total of 12 kg gold seized across multiple outposts, valued at approximately Rs 17 crore
Operations conducted at Gongra, Mahakhola, Pathergata and Patna locations
DRI took over seizures under the Customs Act, 1962, Section 110

oil_falls_on_report_asia_will_import_hig.headline: Asia's Crude Imports Hit Highest Since Iran War, Oil Prices Slip
oil_falls_on_report_asia_will_import_hig.summary: Oil prices fell as Asia's crude imports reached a September peak of 23.96 million barrels per day, the highest level since the US‑Iran war began.
highlights: Brent November futures down 0.81% to $102.25 a barrel
U.S. WTI November futures fell 0.77% to $91.45 a barrel
Iran‑U.S. tensions persist after President Masoud Pezeshkian’s UN remarks

here_s_what_happens_to_the_economy_when_.headline: Treasury Yields Surge to 5.125%, Raising Borrowing Costs for Consumers
here_s_what_happens_to_the_economy_when_.summary: Soaring Treasury yields push the 10‑year benchmark to 5.125%, spiking mortgage and credit rates while offering only modest gains for savers.
highlights: The 10‑year Treasury yield hit 5.125%, its highest level since before the 2008 financial crisis.
30‑year mortgage rates climbed to 7.26%, up over a full percentage point in a year.
Bank stocks fell as higher yields threaten loan demand despite potential margin benefits for banks.

oil_industry_warns_a_diesel_export_ban_w.headline: Trump Weighs Diesel Export Ban Amid Industry Warning of Higher Fuel Prices
oil_industry_warns_a_diesel_export_ban_w.summary: The oil lobby warns that a U.S. diesel export ban could lift gasoline prices by up to 30 cents per gallon, worsening the global fuel crisis.
highlights: API CEO Mike Sommers says restricting exports would exacerbate refining challenges and hurt consumers.
Shares of Valero, Marathon Petroleum and Phillips 66 fell after reports of a potential 90‑day diesel export ban.
Energy Secretary Chris Wright warns a ban would reduce supply and push gasoline prices higher immediately.

proposal_to_recognise_lpg_as_interim_ind.headline: Bangladesh LPG Operators Push for Faster Fuel Approvals Amid Gas Shortages
proposal_to_recognise_lpg_as_interim_ind.summary: Industrial factories facing chronic natural gas shortages are urging the government to recognise LPG as a backup fuel and streamline approval and tax processes.
highlights: LOAB seeks formal LPG recognition as an interim industrial fuel
Proposes time‑bound approvals for bulk storage tanks and vaporizers, cutting the current 1‑1.5‑year wait
Calls for tax and customs duty review to make industrial LPG economically viable

tbsnews.net/bangladesh/court/ekramul-mur.headline: Tribunal Defers Charges Against Sheikh Hasina and Ten Others, Delaying Political Turmoil Impacting
tbsnews.net/bangladesh/court/ekramul-mur.summary: The International Crimes Tribunal‑2 postponed the charge‑framing hearing for former prime minister Sheikh Hasina and ten co‑accused to 27 September, extending political uncertainty.
highlights: Hearing delayed due to incomplete bench of the tribunal
Four accused presented in custody while seven remain absconding
Charges include abduction, illegal detention, staged gunfight and incitement

tbsnews.net/foreign-policy/uns-role-bang.headline: UNDP Praised for Boosting Bangladesh Development Under New Prime Minister
tbsnews.net/foreign-policy/uns-role-bang.summary: Political adviser Zahir Uddin Swapon lauded the United Nations' contribution, urging deeper involvement as Prime Minister Tarique Rahman advances development and welfare programs.
highlights: UNDP Resident Representative Stephen Rodrigues visited the Prime Minister’s office to reaffirm UN commitment.
Discussions included institutional reform initiatives following the July Uprising.

global_debt_tops_365_trillion_as_economi.headline: Global Debt Surpasses $365 Trillion, Raising Alarm Over Vicious Cycle
global_debt_tops_365_trillion_as_economi.summary: Rising bond yields and soaring interest costs have pushed global debt past $365 trillion, prompting economists to warn of a worsening fiscal sustainability crisis.
highlights: State debts rose as medium‑ and long‑term bond yields hit decade‑highs in the U.S., Japan, France and the U.K.
Advanced economies paid over $3.3 trillion in interest on sovereign bonds last year, outpacing global AI, defense and

30_year_treasury_yield_hits_highest_leve.headline: 30‑Year Treasury Yield Reaches Highest Since 2004 Amid Rate‑Hike Speculation
30_year_treasury_yield_hits_highest_leve.summary: U.S. Treasury yields surged to multi‑decade highs as stronger PMI data and rising oil prices fuel expectations of another Federal Reserve rate increase.
highlights: 30‑year Treasury yield rose to 5.438%, its highest level since 2004.
10‑year Treasury yield hit 5.139%, the strongest since July 2007.
Japan’s 10‑year JGB climbed to 3.055%, a peak not seen since 1996.

france_faces_a_fresh_budget_battle_that_.headline: France’s 10‑Year Yield Surpasses 4.5%, Sparking Fresh Budget Crisis
france_faces_a_fresh_budget_battle_that_.summary: Rising risk premiums push France’s 10‑year OAT yield above 4.5%, intensifying a budget showdown that could topple Prime Minister Lecornu’s fragile government.
highlights: OAT yield reached 4.6696%, the highest since 2008
France’s debt‑to‑GDP ratio is projected at 121.7% for 2027, a record level
The OAT‑Bund spread is expected to stay between 100 and 125 basis points

policy_rate_hold_weekend.headline: Bangladesh Bank Holds Rate at 9.5%, Stocks Slip Lower
policy_rate_hold_weekend.summary: Investors disappointed as Bangladesh Bank kept its policy rate at 9.5%, dragging the DSEX down 0.31% and reducing market turnover.
highlights: DSEX fell 17 points to 5,578
Turnover dropped 11% to Tk756 crore
Banking stocks such as Pubali Bank and BRAC Bank led the decline

digital_banks_approval.headline: Bangladesh Bank approves five new digital banks including bKash and Robi ventures
digital_banks_approval.summary: Bangladesh Bank's board gave initial approval to five digital banking projects, featuring bKash, Boost‑Robi, Nova Digital, Kori and a Bhutan‑DK partnership.
highlights: bKash Digital Bank, Boost‑Robi, Digital Banking of Bhutan‑DK, Kori Digital and Nova Digital Bank received initial approval.
Kori Digital missed the document deadline but remains in compliance phase, while Nagad Digital Bank licence was suspended in 2024.

cross_border_trade_settlement_taka.headline: Bangladesh Bank Enables Cross‑Border Trade Settlement in Taka via Vostro Accounts
cross_border_trade_settlement_taka.summary: Bangladesh Bank has approved a framework allowing authorised dealer banks to settle eligible export and import transactions in Taka through non‑resident Taka vostro accounts for correspondent banks.
highlights: AD banks can open Taka vostro accounts for correspondent banks without initial deposits
Balances in these accounts will be used for export payments and other permitted transactions
The rule replaces the earlier requirement of inward remittances in freely convertible currencies

treasury_yields_surge_to_multi_decade_hi.headline: Treasury Yields Surge, Signaling Inflation‑Driven Reality Check for U.S. Economy
treasury_yields_surge_to_multi_decade_hi.summary: Rising 2‑year and 10‑year Treasury yields highlight stubborn inflation, strong growth and a mounting federal debt burden amid Fed‑Treasury policy tensions.
highlights: The 2‑year yield hit 4.87% and the 10‑year reached 5.12%, near multi‑decade highs.
Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent clash over using market signals versus direct

oracle_issues_force_majeure_notice_on_ne.headline: Oracle Issues Force Majeure Notice on New Mexico Data Center Project
oracle_issues_force_majeure_notice_on_ne.summary: Oracle's force majeure notice to delay payments on the New Mexico data center, dubbed Project Jupiter, triggered a 4% share drop amid rising debt concerns.
highlights: Oracle shares fell 4% after the notice
Project Jupiter is slated for 2028 completion but may face payment delays
Blue Owl Capital, the developer unit, also saw its stock decline

people_inc_rescinds_48_30_per_share_take.headline: MGM Resorts Shares Drop 9% After People Inc. Withdraws Offer
people_inc_rescinds_48_30_per_share_take.summary: People Inc. rescinded its $48.30‑per‑share bid for MGM Resorts, citing deal complexity and debt concerns, pushing the casino stock down 9%.
highlights: People Inc. already held a 26.1% stake in MGM Resorts.
Tilman Fertitta’s Caesars deal valued at $17.6 billion was approved this week.

bb_raises_refund_cap_for_depositors_of_4.headline: Bangladesh Bank lifts depositor refund cap to Tk50 lakh for four NBFIs
bb_raises_refund_cap_for_depositors_of_4.summary: Bangladesh Bank announced a new scheme that will repay individual depositors up to Tk50 lakh, with reduced payouts for larger balances, for four failing NBFIs.
highlights: Individual depositors will receive up to Tk50 lakh before any deductions are applied.
Depositors with balances above Tk50 lakh receive scaled refunds, e.g., up to Tk80 lakh for deposits between Tk50 lakh and
The four affected institutions are Aviva Finance, Fareast Finance, FAS Finance and International Leasing.

padma_barrage_to_benefit_one_third_of_ba.headline: Padma Barrage Project Set to Boost One‑Third of Bangladesh’s Economy
padma_barrage_to_benefit_one_third_of_ba.summary: Minister Md Shahiduddin Chowdhury Anee says the Padma Barrage will expand dry‑season agriculture, enhance fisheries and transform regional economies across one‑third of Bangladesh.
highlights: Planned canal excavations will store rainwater, increasing surface‑water availability.
Rising coastal salinity threatens irrigation and drinking water supplies.

bangladesh_moves_closer_to_joining_world.headline: Bangladesh Nears Entry into World’s Largest Free‑Trade Bloc RCEP
bangladesh_moves_closer_to_joining_world.summary: Bangladesh’s accession to RCEP moves forward as ministers approve an ad‑hoc working group to accelerate accession for Bangladesh, Chile, Sri Lanka and Hong Kong.
highlights: The ad‑hoc working group was approved at the fifth RCEP Ministerial Meeting in Manila on 21 September.
Joining RCEP would help Bangladesh maintain preferential market access and attract foreign direct investment after its LDC
All existing RCEP members must consent for Bangladesh to join, requiring diplomatic outreach.

surging_treasury_yields_fed_dilemma.headline: Surging Treasury Yields Force Fed Chair Warsh into New Rate‑Hike Dilemma
surging_treasury_yields_fed_dilemma.summary: Rising Treasury yields, driven by stubborn inflation, energy price spikes and AI‑related debt issuance, compel the Federal Reserve to consider multiple rapid rate hikes.
highlights: 10‑year Treasury yield reached about 5.15%, near a 5.5% level that could cut growth to 1.5% and lift unemployment to 4.7%.
Fed officials now project three to six hikes this year, up from earlier expectations of one.
New York Fed President John Williams sees another hike by year‑end, while Philadelphia Fed’s Anna Paulson calls any further

50m_startup_fund_announcement.headline: Bangladesh Allocates $50 Million Startup Fund for Youth at UNGA
50m_startup_fund_announcement.summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman announced a $50 million allocation to boost youth entrepreneurship, research and innovation, aiming to tap the demographic dividend and reduce the digital divide.
highlights: The fund will be deployed in the current fiscal year
Bangladesh seeks to become a manufacturing hub with support from development partners
The Prime Minister urged the United Nations to adopt a policy framework for AI benefits

lng_transfer_disruption_moheshkhali.headline: Adverse Weather Halts LNG Transfer at Moheshkhali, Cutting National Gas Supply
lng_transfer_disruption_moheshkhali.summary: Rough seas in the Bay of Bengal disrupted LNG offloading at Moheshkhali’s floating terminals, lowering total gas flow to the grid to 2,301 mmcfd.
highlights: National gas supply dropped to 2,301 mmcfd at 6 pm.
Domestic fields provided 1,615 mmcfd while RLNG contributed 686 mmcfd.

ganges_water_sharing_treaty_seek.headline: Bangladesh Pushes for New Ganges Water-Sharing Treaty Ahead of 1996 Accord Expiry
ganges_water_sharing_treaty_seek.summary: Bangladesh's Water Resources Minister announced a push for a fresh Ganges water-sharing treaty with guarantee clauses to secure dry‑season flows and curb monsoon flooding.
highlights: Joint Rivers Commission is drafting a new agreement with guarantee clauses
India’s External Affairs Ministry says treaty issues will be discussed under the bilateral JRC framework
Bangladesh has formed a negotiation team and awaits India's response

30yr_mortgage_rate_jump.headline: 30‑Year Fixed Mortgage Rate Surges to 7.45% Amid Treasury Yield Spike
30yr_mortgage_rate_jump.summary: Mortgage rates jumped to 7.45% as 10‑year Treasury yields climbed, driven by Fed rate expectations, higher oil prices and strong economic data.
highlights: Average 30‑year fixed rate rose 19 basis points to 7.45% in one day.
Yield on the 10‑year U.S. Treasury surged, pushing mortgage rates higher.
Housing market faces weak consumer confidence and limited affordable inventory.

10yr_yield_spike_warning.headline: Rapid 10-Year Treasury Yield Surge Signals New Financial Turbulence
10yr_yield_spike_warning.summary: The 10‑year Treasury yield jumped to over 5.17%, the fastest rise in years, prompting analysts to warn that a financial break‑point may soon emerge.
highlights: 10‑year Treasury yield rose from below 4.6% to over 5.17% in two weeks
Regional banking ETF (KRE) dropped nearly 10%, signaling pressure on banks
Utilities sector fell more than 4%, becoming the S&P 500’s worst performer

snb_rate_hold.headline: Swiss Central Bank Holds Rate at 0% Amid Global Tightening
snb_rate_hold.summary: Switzerland’s central bank kept its key rate at 0%, citing low inflation and a strong franc, while peers raise rates to combat rising price pressures.
highlights: SNB kept the policy rate at 0% despite inflation at 0.8% in August
Traders price a 90% chance of a hike by early 2027, targeting at least 0.75%
The strong Swiss franc acts as a deflationary force by making imports cheaper

bangladeshi_apparel_firms_at_saudi_texti.headline: Bangladeshi Apparel Firms Showcase at Saudi Fashion Expo
bangladeshi_apparel_firms_at_saudi_texti.summary: Eleven Bangladeshi apparel companies are exhibiting in Jeddah, backed by the Export Promotion Bureau, to attract Saudi and regional buyers.
highlights: The Bangladesh pavilion was inaugurated by Consul General Shakhawat Hossain and Saudi business council member Osama Kouakandi.
The exhibition hosts over 550 booths and expects around 10,000 trade visitors from more than 25 countries.

bank_official_on_run_after_tk1_cr_embezz.headline: Agrani Bank Cash Manager Flees After Alleged Tk1 Crore Embezzlement in Munshiganj
bank_official_on_run_after_tk1_cr_embezz.summary: A senior cash manager at Agrani Bank’s Sreenagar branch vanished after allegedly misappropriating at least Tk1 crore from customers, prompting a police complaint and ACC investigation.
highlights: Principal officer Sharif Uddin filed the complaint on 24 September
Customers were urged to submit written complaints by 27 September
Cash manager Sharifuzzaman Sohag had served the branch for over five years

paltan_gulistan_north_south_road_hawker_.headline: Dhaka South City Corporation Bans Hawkers on Paltan‑Gulistan‑North South Road
paltan_gulistan_north_south_road_hawker_.summary: DSCC Administrator Mohammad Abdus Salam ordered the main stretch from Paltan intersection to North South Road to be hawker‑free, threatening immediate legal action for violations.
highlights: Only registered hawkers may operate at designated spots on the eastern footpath near Ramna Bhaban.
Violators will face immediate legal action, with no concessions granted.

yields_tick_higher.headline: U.S. Treasury Yields Rise as Global Bond Selloff Slows
yields_tick_higher.summary: U.S. Treasury yields edged higher on Friday, driven by hawkish Fed remarks and strong data, while bond markets worldwide showed easing selling pressure.
highlights: 10-year Treasury note rose to 5.183%, its highest level since June 2007
30-year bond climbed to 5.476%, matching peaks not seen since 2004
Japanese government bonds and UK gilts fell, easing the global bond selloff

warsh_regime_change.headline: Warsh Accelerates Fed Regime Change Amid Inflation and Market Pushback
warsh_regime_change.summary: After 127 days, Chairman Kevin Warsh reshapes Fed communication and policy focus, but inflation and balance‑sheet constraints limit his ability to enact broader reforms.
highlights: Warsh shortened the post‑meeting news conference and reordered reporter seating alphabetically

us_orders_jump.headline: U.S. Orders Surge Ahead of Trump‑Xi Summit, Survey Shows
us_orders_jump.summary: American firms increased purchases of Chinese goods in September, boosting the U.S. order gauge to 13 as tariff outlook improved before the high‑stakes summit.
highlights: The gauge rose from –12 a year earlier to 13 in September.
Tariff truce extended to January, suspending rare‑earth export controls and higher port fees.
Overall Chinese domestic and export orders remain below last year’s levels.

lng_unloading_resume_sep2026.institution: Ministry of Power, Energy and Mineral Resources
lng_unloading_resume_sep2026.headline: LNG Unloading Resumes, Gas Pressure Normalizes in Bay of Bengal
lng_unloading_resume_sep2026.summary: State Minister Anindya Islam Amit announced that LNG cargoes resumed transfer to FSRUs, restoring gas pressure to normal levels by afternoon.
highlights: LNG unloading restarted at 7:18 am after weather‑related disruption.
Gas pressure in the Bay of Bengal returned to normal by the afternoon.
Minister pledged to consider fuel price adjustments if global energy prices stay low.

urea_fertiliser_seizure_sep2026.headline: Bangladesh Coast Guard Seizes 48 Tonnes Urea Fertiliser in Chattogram Smuggling Raid
urea_fertiliser_seizure_sep2026.summary: The Coast Guard intercepted a midnight shipment at Ichakhali Ghat, confiscating 48,000 kg of urea fertilizer worth Tk33.6 lakh and arresting three suspects.
highlights: 48 tonnes of urea fertilizer were seized from four trucks and a fishing boat.
The operation took place around 1 am on 25 September at Ichakhali Ghat.
Three individuals were detained and handed over to authorities for legal action.

anthropic_blacklist_upheld.headline: Appeals Court Upholds Pentagon Blacklist of Anthropic as Supply Chain Risk
highlights: The 2‑1 decision was written by Judge Gregory Katsas, with Judge Neomi Rao concurring and Judge Karen LeCraft Henderson
The ruling delays immediate effect, allowing Anthropic to seek rehearing or a Supreme Court review.

copilot_business_ai_launch.headline: Microsoft Unveils Unified Copilot App to Challenge Anthropic in Enterprise AI
copilot_business_ai_launch.summary: Microsoft launched a single Copilot app combining coding, cowork and autopilot features, aiming to boost adoption among Office 365 users and compete with Anthropic.
highlights: Less than 7% of the 450 million Office 365 seats currently have Copilot licenses.
The new app will charge usage‑based fees for Cowork, Code and Autopilot modules instead of a flat subscription.

us_china_trade_details.headline: USTR Greer Announces New U.S.-China Trade Agreements on Select Goods
us_china_trade_details.summary: The United States and China have struck agreements to trade agricultural products, medical devices and certain consumer goods on more preferential terms, with details to be released Monday.
highlights: Agreements cover U.S. agricultural products, medical devices and non‑sensitive Chinese consumer goods.
The new “Board of Trade” mechanism aims to keep these items insulated from future tariff hikes.
U.S. goods trade deficit with China has fallen nearly 40% as imports shift toward Mexico.

kpi_framework_for_bank_ceos.headline: Bangladesh Bank Introduces KPI Framework for Bank CEOs, Sparking Governance Debate
kpi_framework_for_bank_ceos.summary: Bangladesh Bank will assess commercial bank CEOs and managing directors semi‑annually on solvency, asset quality and profitability, tying results to pay and appointments.
highlights: KPI scores will determine CEOs' remuneration, incentives and tenure extensions.
Critics warn the framework creates dual loyalty between bank boards and the regulator.
Only a handful of Bangladeshi banks currently have strong governance, according to experts.

spain_investment_potential_bangladesh.headline: Spanish Business Leaders Spot $172 bn Green Investment Potential in Bangladesh
spain_investment_potential_bangladesh.summary: Spanish entrepreneurs view Bangladesh’s textile, renewable energy and tech sectors as gateways for substantial trade growth and $172 bn of green investment by 2030.
highlights: Bilateral trade reached €23.3 billion in 2025, making the EU a key partner
The Madrid Chamber plans a delegation visit to Bangladesh in November
FBCCI offers free land and fixed‑price electricity for renewable‑energy investors

govt_job_competition_21_lakh_applicants.headline: Bangladesh Job Seekers Flood 1,485 Government Posts as Private Sector Stalls
govt_job_competition_21_lakh_applicants.summary: With private‑sector hiring stalled, over 21 lakh applicants vie for just 1,485 social services positions, creating unprecedented recruitment challenges for the government.
highlights: Approximately 1,430 candidates compete for each of the 1,485 vacancies
Application fees ranged from Tk50 to Tk100 via state‑owned Teletalk
Private‑sector bank credit growth stayed below the Bangladesh Bank target of 6.80%

saudi_crude_exports_surge_despite_pipeli.headline: Saudi Crude Exports Hit 6 Million bpd, Highest Since Iran War
saudi_crude_exports_surge_despite_pipeli.summary: In September Saudi Arabia exported 6 million barrels per day of crude, a record level since the Iran‑backed war began, despite a pipeline outage.
highlights: Exports rose 80% from August’s 3.4 million bpd to 6 million bpd in September.
The East‑West pipeline was shut after a drone attack, forcing shipments through the Red Sea terminal at Yanbu and the Strait of
Brent crude briefly spiked to nearly $110 per barrel before easing.

appeals_court_allows_states_to_regulate_.headline: Appeals Court Allows States to Regulate Kalshi Sports Prediction Markets
appeals_court_allows_states_to_regulate_.summary: The 6th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals ruled that Ohio and Tennessee can apply their gambling laws to Kalshi’s sports-event contracts, rejecting CFTC jurisdiction.
highlights: The decision overturns a prior Tennessee district court ruling that favored Kalshi.
The 9th Circuit previously affirmed Nevada’s right to regulate similar contracts as sports bets.

nanexa_stock_soars_after_injectables_dea.headline: Nanexa stock jumps 150% after $1.33 billion Novo licensing deal
nanexa_stock_soars_after_injectables_dea.summary: Swedish micro‑cap Nanexa saw shares surge over 150% as it secured a $1.33 billion global licensing agreement with Novo Nordisk for its PharmaShell injectable technology.
highlights: Nanexa will receive an upfront payment of about $700 million and low single‑digit royalties on future sales.
The deal covers up to five development programs targeting monthly or quarterly dosing for obesity and type‑2 diabetes drugs.

ldc_graduation_deferral_request.headline: Bangladesh Seeks Three‑Year Deferral of LDC Graduation Ahead of UN Vote
ldc_graduation_deferral_request.summary: Bangladesh has asked the UN to postpone its LDC graduation by three years, with the Second Committee set to discuss the request on 7 October.
highlights: Second Committee meeting scheduled for 7 October.
General Assembly will vote on the deferral before the 24 November graduation deadline.

port_committee_statement.headline: Chattogram Port Committee Rejects Minister’s Stagnation Claim, Opposes Foreign Leases
port_committee_statement.summary: The committee says port operations are thriving, criticises the minister’s stagnation remark and warns against long‑term foreign leases of key terminals.
highlights: Local workforce kept the port running despite adverse weather.
Committee demands independent assessment before any long‑term foreign terminal lease.

cox_bazar_road_project_stall.institution: Local Government, Rural Development and Cooperatives Ministry
cox_bazar_road_project_stall.headline: Bangladesh Government Stalled by Environmental Lawyers Over Cox’s Bazar Road Project
cox_bazar_road_project_stall.summary: State Minister Mir Shahe Alam said the government faces setbacks as the Bangladesh Environmental Lawyers Association repeatedly blocks key Cox’s Bazar tourism projects through High Court writs.
highlights: A Tk128 crore road linking Laboni Point to Marine Drive was halted by an eight‑week High Court injunction.
The injunction was filed by the Bangladesh Environmental Lawyers Association over the project's location in an Ecologically
The minister highlighted plans to upgrade Cox’s Bazar to a city corporation and develop an international‑standard tourist

adb_housing_finance_bangladesh.headline: ADB approves $100 million loan to boost affordable housing finance in Bangladesh
adb_housing_finance_bangladesh.summary: The Asian Development Bank will channel a $100 million concessional loan through PKSF and MFIs to provide collateral‑free micro‑loans for low‑ and middle‑income families, especially women, by 2031.
highlights: At least 40,000 households will receive loans, including 32,000 women.
Project incorporates climate‑adaptation measures to make homes resistant to floods, cyclones and extreme heat.

foreign_investors_dhaka_stocks_return.headline: Foreign Investors Return to Dhaka Stock Market as Reforms and MSCI Review Boost Confidence
foreign_investors_dhaka_stocks_return.summary: In September, foreign investors net bought about Tk70 crore of Dhaka shares, spurred by regulatory easing, removal of floor price, and MSCI’s reinstated review.
highlights: Net foreign buying reached Tk70 crore, with purchases outpacing sales on 13 of 24 trading days.
BSEC removed the floor price and revised IPO and margin rules, easing market entry.
Bangladesh Bank raised capital‑repatriation approval threshold to Tk100 crore and scrapped auditor‑certificate requirements.

corruption_evidence_adani_deal.headline: Bangladesh Could Renegotiate Costly Adani Power Deal Amid Corruption Claims
corruption_evidence_adani_deal.summary: Evidence of corruption in the Adani contract may allow Bangladesh to renegotiate the 25‑year power purchase agreement, potentially saving billions in overpayments.
highlights: The deal is estimated to overpay Bangladesh by about $6 billion, with annual excess costs exceeding $500 million.
Capacity charges must be paid for the full 25‑year term even if solar generation reduces electricity draw.
Bangladesh lost over 77 billion cubic feet of gas in transmission and distribution in FY2024‑25.

737max_software_glitch.headline: Boeing Flags 737 Max Software Glitch Impacting Automated Landing Functions
737max_software_glitch.summary: Boeing reported a software glitch on certain 737 Max jets that can disrupt automated approach procedures, prompting the FAA to assess safety and review fixes.
highlights: The glitch may occur after a missed approach when pilots modify a preprogrammed flight path.
Airlines can revert to older software versions, and none of Southwest’s fleet has the affected Version U.14.

trump_cafe_standards.headline: Trump Reverses Biden Fuel Economy Rules, Lowers CAFE Standards
trump_cafe_standards.summary: President Trump announced new, less stringent CAFE fuel economy standards, rolling back Biden-era targets and promising lower vehicle prices while reducing incentives for electric cars.
highlights: New standards are expected to be sharply lower than the 50 mpg target set for 2031 under Biden’s plan
Automakers say the rollback will allow more profitable pickup trucks and SUVs, reducing pressure to produce electric vehicles

pocket_rescission_810m.headline: White House seeks to block $810 million via pocket rescission
pocket_rescission_810m.summary: The administration announced plans to claw back $810 million of congressionally approved funds, invoking a pocket rescission that critics say violates the Impoundment Control Act.
highlights: $567 million for Health and Human Services refugee programs and $28 million for research are targeted for cuts
The Government Accountability Office says the Impoundment Control Act does not permit rescissions without congressional approval
Senator Susan Collins denounces the move as an unconstitutional breach of Congress’s power of the purse

pksf_tk7_245cr_financing.headline: PKSF approves Tk7,245 crore financing for microenterprises and rooftop solar
pksf_tk7_245cr_financing.summary: PKSF will channel Tk7,245 crore into micro‑enterprise growth and a Tk500 crore rooftop solar scheme, offering 6% loans through partner organisations.
highlights: Tk5,000 crore of the financing comes from Bangladesh Bank‑backed loans for cottage sector entrepreneurs.
Nearly Tk2,000 crore will be lent to partner organisations for cluster‑based microenterprises and ultra‑poor support.

dse_investor_activity_42pct_jump.headline: Investor Activity Surges 42% on DSE Amid Economic Headwinds
dse_investor_activity_42pct_jump.summary: Investor activity on the Dhaka Stock Exchange jumped 42% to Tk785 crore, driven by bargain hunting despite higher fuel prices and an unchanged policy rate.

Total market capitalisation fell by Tk1,800 crore over the week

teesta_project_delay_2029_start.headline: Bangladesh Delays Teesta River Basin Project Until Post‑2029 After New Feasibility Study

highlights: The study will evaluate erosion, flooding, sediment dynamics and water scarcity across five northern districts.
China has offered technical assistance and a $550.62 million loan for the first phase.

10yr_yield_peak.headline: 10‑Year Treasury Yield Hits 5.23% Highest Since 2007 Amid AI‑Driven Bond Surge
10yr_yield_peak.summary: The benchmark 10‑year Treasury yield jumped to 5.23%, its strongest level since 2007, as investors price in stubborn inflation and a wave of AI‑related bond issuance.
highlights: Fed funds futures indicate a 64% chance of an October rate hike.
U.S. corporate AI spending has driven debt issuance to $132 billion through July, far above the 2020‑2024 average.
Bond yields and prices move inversely, meaning higher yields pressure stock valuations.

fedwatch_yield_forecast.headline: 10‑Year Treasury Yield Could Reach 6% by Jan 2027, Threatening Housing and Growth
fedwatch_yield_forecast.summary: Analyst Ben Emons warns that a 6% 10‑year yield would lift real rates above 3.5%, tightening finance, spiking market volatility and squeezing the housing sector.

Higher borrowing costs may slow corporate investment and push the housing market into a crunch.

ai_debt_cost_risk.headline: AI‑Driven Debt Surge Faces Higher Costs as Treasury Yields Spike
ai_debt_cost_risk.summary: Rising 10‑year Treasury yields near 5.17% are pushing AI infrastructure borrowers to shoulder steeper financing costs, threatening profit margins across the sector.
